court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Mrs. Alpa Viren Panchal vs Mr. Viren Ashok Panchal
facts_of_case: Applicant is the wife and Respondent is the husband.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for divorce under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is maintainable only if the petitioner has been living separately from the respondent for a period of at least one year immediately preceding the presentation of the petition.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that a petition for divorce under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is maintainable only if the petitioner has been living separately from the respondent for a period of at least one year immediately preceding the presentation of the petition.
use_in: divorce cases under Hindu Marriage Act

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to prove that there has been a breakdown of marriage and that it is not possible for the parties to live together.
legal_principles.held: It is held that the burden lies on the applicant to prove that there has been a breakdown of marriage and that it is not possible for the parties to live together.
use_in: divorce cases under Hindu Marriage Act

outcome.final_order: Counsel for the Applicant is directed to produce on record copy of the proceedings for divorce initiated under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act so also of the proceedings under D.V. Act. Stand over to 19th April, 2022.
